tagline: Reviews digline commands that spend model calls, write under .digline/, or can promote a baseline.
summary: Reviews digline run, rejudge, promote, register, migrate, and view, which spend model calls, write under .digline/, or expose a way to change the approved baseline. Read-only commands, help, and migrate --dry-run stay automatic.
limitations: Coverage matches digline subcommand names; it does not resolve arguments as paths under .digline/.
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
